gaps.criterion_why: A scene's stated mod list must be the list it needs, and the fix itself claims to state the Cauldron's dependencies but states them wrongly.
gaps.observed: Each start line reads 'the Cauldron (mandrake.rm.cauldron) and its dependencies (mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards, mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors), each asserted active'. src/RimMandrake/Cauldron/About/About.xml lists four modDependencies: brrainz.harmony, mandrake.rm.flowworks, mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards and mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors [measured]. sc_cover_breaks and sc_gas_shove_into_pit assert FlowWorks in a separate line; sc_gas_chain, sc_cauldron_gas and sc_settings_sweep never name it. RimWorld loads a mod whose dependency is missing with only a warning, so 'Cauldron active' does not imply FlowWorks is loaded [guess ~75%].

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: add mandrake.rm.flowworks to the Cauldron dependency clause in sc_gas_chain, sc_cauldron_gas, sc_cover_breaks, sc_gas_shove_into_pit and sc_settings_sweep

gaps.what: The Cauldron's dependency list stated in the gas scenes omits mandrake.rm.flowworks, so three scenes state and assert an incomplete list
gaps.where: scenes.json sc_gas_chain, sc_cauldron_gas, sc_settings_sweep start lines (the same wording in sc_cover_breaks and sc_gas_shove_into_pit)
gaps.would_pass: In all five scenes the Cauldron start line names mandrake.rm.flowworks among its dependencies, asserted active, INVALID otherwise. A script comparing each scene's stated Cauldron dependencies with the Cauldron About.xml modDependencies (Harmony excepted) finds no difference.

gaps.criterion_why: An expect that a correct build fails because the staging kills the subject is a staging defect, not a property of the mod.
gaps.observed: The scene stages 'a Bomb explosion ... at radius 2.9 ... and damage 50', then 100, one cell from a 12 kg rat and a colonist. No start line shields them from the blast's injuries. A 50-damage bomb very likely kills a rat, and a 100-damage blast can kill or down a colonist [guess ~75%]. A killed pawn is thrown by the goods rule (sheet.md:33: 'a pawn the blast kills among them, fly wild: about 1.6 times as far'), which breaks the stated cells and 'alive and stunned'. The existing proof's Blast helper (RM_KnockbackProof.cs:588-590) stages damage 1 [measured]: that convention keeps pawns unhurt, but under blastPowerFromDamage (default on) it throws at 1/50 of the force. No scene states the damage it stages.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json sc_mass_and_power start: add the injury-absorbing hook and its assertion; one line on the staged-damage convention in the prose of RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_KNOCKBACK_CREATURE_MASS_AND_BLAST_POWER

gaps.what: sc_mass_and_power stages real Bomb damage (50, then 100) one cell from a rat and a colonist, with nothing to keep them alive, yet expects each thrown creature 'alive and stunned' at its kernel cells
gaps.where: scenes.json sc_mass_and_power start (blast line) and expect; tree.json heavier_flies_less
gaps.would_pass: sc_mass_and_power gains a start line: a test hook absorbs the staged explosion's injury on the four creatures (asserted: no new hediff after either run), while the journal's damage ratio is still read from the explosion's damage. The expect keeps 'alive and stunned'. The entry_point_item's prose states that scenes staging a 'grenade' or 'shell' use that projectile's real damage (ratio 1.0), with the same hook wherever survival is expected.

gaps.criterion_why: A leaf's oracle must be what its scene checks, and an asserted start band must not admit states the expect then fails.
gaps.observed: The leaf oracle reads 'the creature mass limit at 250 kg throws the thrumbo (1 then 3 cells)', but the control runs only 'the damage-50 run with creatureMassLimit 250', so the 3-cell result at double damage is never staged. From RM_KnockbackMath.cs ThrowCells (4 x 0.655 x sqrt(70/m), rounded away from zero) [measured from code], a colonist over 76.9 kg throws 2 cells at damage 50, the same as the muffalo. Masses of 77 to 90 kg pass the scene's asserted 'colonist 60 to 90', then fail 'within each run rat > colonist > muffalo > thrumbo'.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json sc_mass_and_power: add the 250 kg damage-100 control lane (or trim the 'then 3' in tree.json heavier_flies_less), and narrow the colonist band to 60-76 kg

gaps.where: tree.json heavier_flies_less oracle_proposed; scenes.json sc_mass_and_power start (masses), expect, control
gaps.would_pass: Either the control adds the damage-100 run at creatureMassLimit 250, expecting the thrumbo at 3 cells, or the leaf oracle drops 'then 3'. The colonist band reads 60 to 76 kg, so every admitted mass gives 3 cells at damage 50 and 5 at damage 100 by ThrowCells.

gaps.criterion_why: The sweep's rule that each change alters only its own outcome is right; this clause overstates that outcome.
gaps.observed: The expect reads 'the double-damage blast throws each pawn farther than the frag grenade at default'. The lane holds 'a wall behind one colonist, a closed door behind another' and 'a colonist with a charged shield belt'. A wall or door stops a throw dead at the same cell at either damage (sheet.md:29), and an absorbing belt keeps its wearer in place at both (sheet.md:32). 'Each pawn farther' therefore fails on a correct build.
